description: Regression corpus for positions::calculate_locked_collateral (share-collateral math, #334). Each case documents intent so a future change that reintroduces a rounding/saturation bug fails CI immediately. See contracts/market/src/positions.rs::calculate_locked_collateral and the loader test in contracts/market/src/tests_vectors.rs.

vectors.description: Equal YES and NO shares are fully hedged and lock zero collateral regardless of price.
Net YES position locks net_yes * price / 10000.
Net NO position locks net_no * (10000 - price) / 10000.
999 * 2500 / 10000 = 249.75, must floor to 249, never round up.
i128::MAX shares at a 100% price overflows the intermediate multiply; scale_by_bps must saturate to i128::MAX before dividing rather than wrapping or panicking.
